title: The Bell Beneath the Prairie
rumor: The Bell Beneath the Prairie. A deep metallic tolling can sometimes be heard beneath the grasslands shortly before sunrise. Farmers claim the sound comes from an old buried chapel, while others insist it is the ringing of a bell carried by a subterranean river. Wherever the sound originates, livestock become unusually restless before it begins.
first_lead: A cluster of abandoned homesteads marks the area where the bell is heard most frequently.
